lines.text: Jehoiachin became king at eighteen, reigned in Jerusalem three months, and did evil in the sight of the LORD.
Nebuchadnezzar's servants marched up to Jerusalem and besieged it, and then Nebuchadnezzar himself came to the city.
Jehoiachin and his mother surrendered to Babylon's king, who took him captive in the twelfth year of his reign.
Nebuchadnezzar took the treasures, cut up the gold articles David made, and exiled ten thousand, leaving only the poorest people.
The king of Babylon made Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king and changed his name to Zedekiah.
